title: God's Judgment Day is Coming & It's Gonna Be INTENSE
paragraphs: §No Longer Giving God a Thought or a Prayer

Alright, so this is a message from God, and it's for this dude Zephaniah. He's the son of Cushi, who's the son of Gedaliah, who's the son of Amariah, who's the son of Hezekiah. This all went down when Josiah, son of Amon, was king of Judah.
God's dropping a decree, and it's intense. He's like, 'I'm about to totally wipe the earth clean, like a full-on deep clean.'
'I'm talking everyone and everything—dudes, girls, animals, even birds and fish. Anything that's causing people to mess up, it's gone. But yeah, especially the people.'

'I'm starting with Judah and everyone in Jerusalem. I'm gonna sweep the place clean of every trace of those sketchy sex-and-religion Baal shrines and their priests. And those people who go up on their roofs at night to worship stars? They're out. Same for the people who say they worship God but are also praying to other gods just in case. And don't even get me started on the ones who've totally ghosted God and don't even think about him anymore.'

'Yo, be quiet! Show some respect for God, the Master. Time's up. Judgment Day is coming, for real. The Holy Day is set, and the guests are ready. On that day, I'm gonna deal with the leaders and the princes, and anyone dressing up like foreign priests and priestesses, bringing in all their weird prayers. And I'm gonna deal with everyone who's bringing in pagan superstitions that turn holy places into hellholes. Judgment Day is coming, for real!' God's decree! 'You're gonna hear panic from the Fish Gate, screams from the Second Quarter, and crashing from the hills! All you shopkeepers on Market Street, you better cry, 'cause your money-making days are over. The god of money is dead. On Judgment Day, I'm gonna search every corner of Jerusalem. I'll find all those lazy people who are just sitting around, thinking, 'God doesn't do anything, good or bad. He's not involved, so why should we be?' But just you wait. They're gonna lose everything—their money, their houses, their land. They'll build houses and never live in them. They'll plant vineyards and never even get to taste the wine.'
§A Day of Darkness at Noon

'The great Judgment Day of God is almost here. It's the final countdown... seven, six, five, four... It's gonna be a bitter and loud day, even the tough guys will be screaming for help. Judgment Day is payday—and I'm paying out my anger. It's gonna be a day of total chaos and pain, a day of darkness and storms, a day of war cries as cities get attacked. I'm gonna make things so bad, people won't know what hit them. They'll be stumbling around like they're blind. They've sinned against God! Their blood will be poured out like dirty water, and their insides will be thrown out like trash. Don't even think about trying to buy your way out of this. Your money is worthless. This is the Day of God's Judgment—my anger! I'm passionate about getting rid of sin—a fire that will burn up this corrupt world and all the corrupt people in it.'

title: God's Dropping the Hammer on Everyone
paragraphs: §Seek God

Alright, listen up. You guys need to get it together, for real. You're a nation that's totally clueless. You better shape up before you get blown away like dust in the wind, before God's crazy anger hits you, before the final day of judgment goes down.
So look for God, all you humble people who actually follow his rules. Try to do what's right. Live a quiet, disciplined life. Maybe, just maybe, you'll get a pass on the day God's anger is unleashed.
§All Earth-Made Gods Will Blow Away

Gaza is about to be totally wrecked. Ashdod is getting cleared out by noon. Ekron is getting ripped out from the ground up. It's the end for the people by the sea, the folks from Crete. God's word is bad news for you who live in Canaan, the land of the Philistines: 'You're getting destroyed. No one's gonna be left.'

The land by the sea will turn into a big pasture, a place for shepherds and their sheep. The survivors from Judah's family will get it all. They'll let their flocks graze by the sea during the day and then crash in Ashkelon at night. Their own God will watch out for them and make everything good again, just like before.

'I've heard all the nasty things Moab has said, and the insults from Ammon. They've been dissing my people and acting all high and mighty on Israel's borders. So, as sure as I'm the living God,' says the Lord of Angel Armies, Israel's personal God, 'Moab is gonna end up like Sodom, and Ammon like Gomorrah—a field of weeds and a salty wasteland, a total ruin forever. What's left of my people will take them over and clean them out. This is what they get for being so proud and for mocking the people of the God of Angel Armies. God's gonna show them how terrifying he is. All the man-made gods will just shrivel up and disappear. And everyone, no matter where they are, will bow down and worship him. And yeah, you Ethiopians too—you're gonna die. I'll make sure of it.'

Then God's gonna reach up north and destroy Assyria. He'll turn Nineveh into a wasteland, as dry and empty as a desert. That ghost town of a city will be a hangout for wild animals. Raccoons and coyotes will be bedding down in the ruins. Owls will be hooting from the windows, and ravens will be croaking in the doorways. All that fancy woodwork will just be a perch for birds. Is this really that super fun city that thought it was the best, the one that bragged, 'I'm the Number-One City! I'm King of the Mountain!'? Well, look at it now—a total dump, a place for wild animals. People who walk by just shake their heads and move on.

title: From Total Mess to Total Blessing
paragraphs: §Sewer City

Man, it's over for that rebel city, the one full of bullies—Sewer City, for real. The city that wouldn't take advice, wouldn't accept being called out, wouldn't trust God, and wouldn't even get close to Him. Its own leaders are like hungry lions, its judges are like wolves prowling for their next meal. Its prophets are total fakes, just looking out for themselves. You can't trust them. Its priests desecrate the Sanctuary and use God's law like a weapon to maim and kill souls. But God is still there, in the middle of it all, totally righteous and untouched by the evil. He's at it day after day, serving justice. He never stops. But the evil people, with zero shame, just keep on doing their thing.
God says, “I literally wiped out other nations. I tore down their defenses and trashed their streets so no one could pass. Their cities were left completely empty, total ghost towns.”

“I thought, ‘Surely now they’ll respect me, take my advice, and escape the punishment I have planned.’ But nope. It didn't even bother them. They got up bright and early and went right back to their old, messed-up ways.”

God's decree is like, “Fine, if that's what you want, just wait. Your court date is coming, and I'll be there with the receipts. I'm gathering all the nations and kingdoms to pour out my anger on them. My passion is a fire that will literally purify the whole earth.”
§God Is in Charge at the Center

“But in the end, I'm gonna flip the script for the people. I'll give them a pure language, so they can all worship God together, united, working as a team. They'll come from all over, even from beyond the rivers of Ethiopia, praying and bringing offerings. All my scattered, exiled people will come home. You won't have to be ashamed of your rebellious past anymore. I'll get rid of your arrogant leaders. No more flexing on my holy hill. I'll leave a core group of humble people, what's left of Israel, who will truly rely on God. This holy crew won't do wrong. They won't lie or try to manipulate people. They'll be content and live in peace, no anxiety.”

So sing, Zion! Shout it out, Israel! Be happy and celebrate, Jerusalem! God has cancelled the charges against you and made your enemies run. From now on, God is Israel's king, right in the center of everything. You'll never have to fear evil again!
§God Is Present Among You

Jerusalem will be told: “Don’t be scared. Dear Zion, don’t give up. Your God is with you; he's a mighty Warrior who is here to save you. He's so happy to have you back. He will calm you with his love and sing over you with joy.”

“The sadness from your time in exile will be gone. I, your God, will get rid of it for you. You've carried that weight long enough. At the same time, I'll deal with everyone who made your life a living nightmare. I'll heal the broken and bring home the lost. In the very places where they were shamed, they will be famous. On that day, I'll bring you all back home—a massive family reunion! You'll be famous and honored all over the world. You'll see it with your own eyes—all those painful goodbyes turned into joyful reunions!” That's God's promise.
